trial_court: Additional District Judge (Ad hoc), Amritsar, FAO No. 252-M of 2006

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Gurbux Singh, Principal in ITI College, Sirhali, Amritsar (husband)
parties.respondent_defendant: Harminder Kaur, Librarian in Government Institute DIET at Verka, Amritsar (wife)

facts_of_case: Appellant filed petition under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 for a decree of divorce against respondent-wife on ground of `cruelty'. Both courts rejected claim on ground that appellant failed to prove `cruelty' sufficient for grant of a decree of divorce.

legal_principles.principle: The concept of 'mental cruelty' cannot be defined comprehensively, and no court should attempt to do so.
legal_principles.held: On proper analysis and scrutiny of the judgments of this Court and other courts, we have come to the definite conclusion that there cannot be any comprehensive definition of the concept of 'mental cruelty' within which all kinds of cases of mental cruelty can be covered.
cited_cases: Samar Ghosh vs. Jaya Ghosh, (2007) 4 SCC 511

legal_principles.principle: Courts should not attempt to define 'mental cruelty' comprehensively.
legal_principles.held: No court in our considered view should even attempt to do so.
cited_cases: Samar Ghosh vs. Jaya Ghosh, (2007) 4 SCC 511

outcome.final_order: Both courts have rejected the claim of the Appellant herein on the ground that he has failed to prove `cruelty' sufficient for grant of a decree of divorce.
